factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials section states: 'Operating profit for 2025 was EUR 14.7 million (2024: EUR 0.1 million)' and the KPI table shows operating margin of 28% (2025) vs 1% (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Net profit was EUR 12.0 million, reversing the EUR 3.9 million net loss recorded in the previous year.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials section states: 'The Group’s net profit for the twelve months of 2025 was EUR 12.0 million (2024: EUR 3.9 million loss)'.

factual_claims.claim: Earnings per share increased to EUR 0.22 from a loss of EUR 0.06.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 20 states earnings per share were EUR 0.22 (2025) vs EUR -0.06 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Fourth-quarter net profit was EUR 6.0 million, compared with EUR 0.2 million in the corresponding period of 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key financials section states: 'The net profit for the fourth quarter was EUR 6.0 million (fourth quarter of 2024: EUR 0.2 million)'.

factual_claims.claim: The results also benefited from a EUR 3.5 million fair-value gain on investment property, compared with EUR 1.1 million in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 9 states: 'In 2025, the valuation resulted in a fair value increase of EUR 3.5 million (2024: EUR 1.1 million), which was recognised as other operating income in the consolidated statement of profit or loss.'

factual_claims.claim: Finance costs declined to EUR 2.6 million from EUR 4.3 million, partly because 2024 included a EUR 1.4 million loss related to the modification of financial liabilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 19 shows finance costs of EUR 2,615 thousand (2025) vs EUR 4,276 thousand (2024). Note 11 states: 'In accordance with IFRS 9, the change in the interest rate and maturity date was accounted for as a modification of the financial liability, resulting in the recognition of a modification loss of EUR 1.4 million in profit or loss as a finance cost' for 2024.

factual_claims.claim: These gains were partly offset by an EUR 863 thousand impairment of goodwill related to the Italian Preatoni Nuda Proprietà business, whose projections reflected delayed profitability and dependence on additional financing.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 4 details a EUR 863 thousand impairment loss on goodwill arising from the acquisition of Preatoni Nuda Proprietà S.r.l., stating: 'the revised projections reflected a deferral of the project's profitability compared to the initial business plan, as well as the dependence of the projected cash flows on obtaining additional financing.'

factual_claims.claim: Cash flow improved materially, with EUR 10.8 million generated from operating activities compared with EUR 10.4 million used in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated interim statements of cash flows show 'Net cash generated by/used in operating activities' of EUR 10,814 thousand (2025) vs EUR -10,355 thousand (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Year-end cash increased to EUR 5.1 million from EUR 4.3 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated interim statements of cash flows show cash and cash equivalents at 31 December 2025 of EUR 5,143 thousand vs EUR 4,344 thousand at 31 December 2024.

factual_claims.claim: The Group also redeemed EUR 9.4 million of secured bonds, reducing their outstanding nominal amount to EUR 10.5 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Note 11 states: 'On 20 August 2025, the Group further partially redeemed EUR 9.405 million of the bonds... Following the repayment, the total outstanding nominal amount of the bonds decreased from EUR 19.95 million to EUR 10.545 million.'

factual_claims.claim: Total liabilities declined to EUR 61.2 million from EUR 67.5 million, while equity increased to EUR 63.3 million from EUR 51.2 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated interim statement of financial position shows total liabilities of EUR 61,163 thousand (2025) vs EUR 67,537 thousand (2024), and total equity of EUR 63,327 thousand (2025) vs EUR 51,221 thousand (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The debt-to-equity ratio improved to 0.97 from 1.32, and net asset value per share rose to EUR 1.12 from EUR 0.89.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key performance indicators table shows debt/equity ratio of 0.97 (2025) vs 1.32 (2024), and net asset value per share of EUR 1.12 (2025) vs EUR 0.89 (2024).

factual_claims.claim: Operationally, Kalaranna was completed, Uus-Kindrali handovers began, and construction of the Blue Marine project in Riga started, supported by a new construction loan.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Chairman's summary states: 'In Riga, construction activities continued on the Blue Marine project... During the fourth quarter, a construction loan was closed with BluOr Bank.' Management report also confirms completion of Kalaranna and commencement of handovers in Uus-Kindrali.

factual_claims.claim: In Vilnius, City Villas reached its final stage and initial units were handed over.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Chairman's summary states: 'During the fourth quarter, construction activity in the final stage of Šaltinių Namai Attico with City Villas and a commercial building, is nearing completion. In December 2025, the first real rights agreements were signed, and the initial residential units were handed over to customers.'

factual_claims.claim: Hotel performance remained slightly below budget as occupancy declined to 65% from 67%, while Italian operations faced subdued real estate market activity.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Hotel operations section states: 'The twelve months performance remained slightly below budget... Towards the end of the year, occupancy levels softened across both the leisure and corporate segments, reflecting broader market conditions... The Group's operations in Italy consist of commission income from residential real estate brokerage services... Market activity during the period remained subdued.'

factual_claims.claim: Overall, 2025 marked a strong recovery, supported by project completions, higher property sales, improved cash generation and reduced leverage, although market demand, financing conditions and the performance of the Italian business remained important risks.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Conclusion section states: '2025 was a strong and profitable year for the Group... Looking back on the year, I am particularly proud of the professionalism... With a focused team, a solid and visible pipeline, and supportive market conditions, we successfully converted stability into sustainable growth.' Risks section identifies market, liquidity and financing risks, including 'A significant business risk may arise from another economic downturn... affecting the Group's operating activities' and specifically mentions challenges in Italian operations.
